triggers.name: audit_takeoff_item_decisions
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER audit_takeoff_item_decisions AFTER UPDATE ON public.takeoff_items FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((old.designation IS DISTINCT FROM new.designation) OR (old.quantity IS DISTINCT FROM new.quantity) OR (old.quantity_entered_by IS DISTINCT FROM new.quantity_entered_by) OR (old.unit IS DISTINCT FROM new.unit) OR (old.source_page IS DISTINCT FROM new.source_page) OR (old.evidence IS DISTINCT FROM new.evidence) OR (old.is_excluded IS DISTINCT FROM new.is_excluded) OR (old.exclusion_reason IS DISTINCT FROM new.exclusion_reason) OR (old.is_verified IS DISTINCT FROM new.is_verified) OR (old.verified_by IS DISTINCT FROM new.verified_by) OR (old.verification_justification IS DISTINCT FROM new.verification_justification) OR (old.quantity_entry_category IS DISTINCT FROM new.quantity_entry_category) OR (old.quantity_entry_note IS DISTINCT FROM new.quantity_entry_note))) EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_takeoff_item_decisions()

triggers.name: enforce_takeoff_apply_security
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER enforce_takeoff_apply_security BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON public.takeoff_jobs FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((new.status = 'applied'::takeoff_job_status) AND (old.status IS DISTINCT FROM new.status))) EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_takeoff_apply_security()

constraints.definition: CHECK (((fo_price_origin IS NULL) OR ((jsonb_typeof(fo_price_origin) = 'object'::text) AND (fo_price_origin ?& ARRAY['selection_id'::text, 'kind'::text, 'source_id'::text, 'transport_mode'::text]) AND ((fo_price_origin - ARRAY['selection_id'::text, 'kind'::text, 'source_id'::text, 'transport_mode'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND ((fo_price_origin ->> 'kind'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['supplier'::text, 'reference'::text])) AND ((fo_price_origin ->> 'selection_id'::text) ~ '^[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$'::text) AND ((fo_price_origin ->> 'source_id'::text) ~ '^[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$'::text) AND (((fo_price_origin -> 'transport_mode'::text) = 'null'::jsonb) OR ((fo_price_origin ->> 'transport_mode'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['included'::text, 'excluded'::text]))))))
